verdict.rationale: Evidence describes Titan as a FIDO/U2F/FIDO2 security key for Google Account, Advanced Protection, and general FIDO CTAP1 sites; there is no mention of PIV smart card functionality, certificate-based login, workstation sign-in via CAC/PIV, VPN client certs, or code-signing key storage. missing for 10: PIV/CCID applet support, certificate enrollment/storage, workstation/VPN certificate-based auth, code-signing key generation and non-exportability documentation.
